LOAN AGREEMENT

1. THE FACILITY
The Lender agrees to advance to the Borrower a sum of Rs. 5,00,000 repayable over thirty-six months in equal monthly instalments. The Key Fact Statement setting out all charges is annexed and forms part of this agreement.

2. INTEREST
Interest shall accrue at the External Benchmark Lending Rate published by the Lender plus a spread of two percent. Any change in the benchmark shall be notified to the Borrower in writing at least fifteen days before it takes effect.

3. DEFAULT CHARGES
If an instalment is not paid on its due date, the Lender may levy a penal charge of Rs. 500 per instalment. This charge is a separate fee and is not added to the rate of interest. No interest shall be computed on any penal charge levied. The quantum and the reason for the charge are stated in the Key Fact Statement annexed to this agreement.

4. ACCELERATION
If the Borrower fails to pay any instalment, the Lender shall give written notice specifying the default and allow thirty days to remedy it. Only if the default is not remedied within that period may the Lender declare the outstanding balance immediately due.

5. SET-OFF
The Lender may set off sums due under this agreement only against the loan account itself. No other account of the Borrower held with the Lender shall be debited without the Borrower's prior written consent.

6. PREPAYMENT
The Borrower may repay the whole or any part of the outstanding principal at any time without penalty or foreclosure charge.

7. SECURITY AND REPOSSESSION
The loan is secured against the asset described in Schedule A. Before taking possession of the secured asset the Lender shall give the Borrower thirty days written notice and a reasonable opportunity to regularise the account.

8. INSURANCE
The Borrower shall keep the secured asset insured. The Borrower may choose any insurer registered with the IRDAI and is under no obligation to purchase insurance through the Lender or any entity nominated by it.

9. ASSIGNMENT
The Lender may assign this loan to another regulated entity, and shall notify the Borrower in writing within thirty days of doing so. The terms of this agreement shall not change on assignment.

10. GOVERNING LAW AND DISPUTES
This agreement is governed by the laws of India. Any dispute shall be referred to arbitration before a sole arbitrator appointed jointly by the parties, seated in the city where the Borrower resides.
